text: The work of the eyes is done. Go now and do the heart-work on the images imprisoned within you.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke
visual_brief: An industrial design sketch of an optical bellows camera slowly folding inward into a compact, protective wooden keepsake case. Faint dashed construction lines and curved arrows show the mechanical collapse from external lens to shielded interior core.
alt: Technical sketch of an optical bellows folding into a protective case.
